Training for Kingdom Service

Nehemia Bible Training College

"Study to show yourself approved unto God." — 2 Timothy 2:15

Why We Built a College

Because the harvest demands more than good intentions — it demands prepared laborers.

As Nehemia Worship Center expanded from one congregation to fifteen, Bishop David Walukhu faced a critical question: who would shepherd these new places? The answer was not to import leaders — it was to grow them. The Nehemia Bible Training College was born from the conviction that the church must raise leaders from its own soil — men and women who understand the Scriptures, who walk in prayer, and who have been tested in community before they are sent.

Our college is not a degree factory. It is a greenhouse for character, gifting, and calling. Students are trained in theology, pastoral care, worship leadership, and practical evangelism — and they do it alongside a living church that practices what it preaches. This is education the way Jesus designed it: in motion, in relationship, in the field.

What We Teach

A curriculum shaped by the Word, tested in ministry, and empowered by the Spirit.

Scripture & Theology

Deep study of the Bible — Old and New Testament survey, hermeneutics, doctrine, and biblical worldview.

Prayer & Spiritual Formation

Developing a life of intercession, fasting, spiritual warfare, and personal holiness.

Pastoral Ministry

Counseling, family ministry, church administration, conflict resolution, and shepherding skills.

Worship Leadership

Leading congregational worship with theological depth, musical excellence, and prophetic sensitivity.

Evangelism & Missions

Practical tools for reaching communities, planting churches, and sustaining outreach ministries.

Leadership & Administration

Developing vision, organizational stewardship, team building, and ethical governance in ministry.

Who Should Apply

This college is for those who have heard the call and want to answer it well.

Your Next Step

Is This You?

  • You feel called to pastoral or teaching ministry
  • You are serving in a Nehemia Worship Center and want deeper training
  • You want to plant a church or lead outreach in your community
  • You desire theological grounding alongside practical ministry experience
  • You are a youth leader, worship leader, or evangelist ready for the next level

"And the things you have heard... entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others." — 2 Timothy 2:2

Apply to Nehemia Bible Training College

Enrollment is open. Whether you are a first-time student or a seasoned leader seeking deeper formation, we welcome your application. Come and be equipped for the work God has placed in your hands.
